title: Technical English — Course 4, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 13

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When does the session begin?
tasks.audioText: The maintenance engineering tutor will discuss condition monitoring on Monday at eleven. Students should bring the sample vibration-trend chart. The lesson will explain how repeated measurements reveal equipment trends and why unusual readings must be checked.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which material should students bring?
tasks.audioText: The maintenance engineering tutor will discuss condition monitoring on Monday at eleven. Students should bring the sample vibration-trend chart. The lesson will explain how repeated measurements reveal equipment trends and why unusual readings must be checked.

tasks.prompt: Predictive maintenance uses condition information to estimate when equipment may require attention. Repeated vibration or temperature measurements can reveal a developing trend. A single unusual value may result from measurement error or changing operating conditions, so it should be checked against the method and other evidence. Decisions should follow the approved procedure. Reading 1. What can repeated measurements reveal?
options: A developing trend in equipment condition

tasks.prompt: Why should one unusual value be checked?
options: It may result from measurement error or changing operating conditions

tasks.prompt: Choose TWO details relevant to predictive maintenance data.
options: The relevant technical component or evidence

tasks.prompt: Choose the most appropriate professional response.
options: Check the measurement method and compare the result with other evidence.
I will copy an unrelated record.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of predictive maintenance data in a logical order.
options: Follow the approved maintenance decision process
Check unusual values against other evidence
correctOrder: Check unusual values against other evidence
Follow the approved maintenance decision process

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining how condition-monitoring data supports predictive maintenance. Include why trends and verification matter.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: content and task completion (0–2); organisation and linking (0–2); grammar and sentence structure (0–2); technical vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2).
